title: HPF AI Disclosure Schema
description: JSON Schema for HPF AI Disclosure metadata. Consultation proposal, not a final v1.0 commitment. hpf_standard_version and hpf_classification are required when an HPF record is present. The version field was named hpf_taxonomy_version before 0.9.2; a record using the old name is a record made under the earlier draft. hpf_descriptors is a proposed, provisional field introduced in the August 2026 revision. altered_performance applies to an assistive_ai or a generative_ai record; every other descriptor applies to generative_ai only; none applies to no_ai. Descriptor meanings are defined by the version named in hpf_standard_version, so a stable value has a stable meaning for a given version. Where no HPF declaration exists, omit the record entirely rather than writing null field values. Published by Human Provenance in Film under CC BY 4.0.

hpf_standard_version.description: The version of the HPF AI Disclosure Standard applied to this record.

hpf_classification.description: The HPF disclosure category for this production. Derived from a signed producer declaration held in the chain of title.

hpf_descriptors.description: PROPOSED and PROVISIONAL. Consultation field introduced in the August 2026 revision. Identifies the type or types of AI-generated or AI-modified content present. It never determines or changes the classification and carries no threshold. altered_performance may appear on an assistive_ai or a generative_ai record; every other value applies to generative_ai only; no descriptor applies to no_ai. Values are provisional and may change before v1.0.
